answer: Written in a dense architectural vocabulary, precise comma splices register, it stays short. The design leans on deterministic state transitions verified by pseudo-random validator committees. Reaching the velvet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the orchard of a task receipt, and the canyon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
